mentions.name: Ravioli
mentions.description: Collaborative AI companion app featuring a shared companion named Jino that you can talk to together with other people in one chat. Jino acts as a 'mutual friend' that helps couples, friends, and family understand each other, resolve misunderstandings, and stay on the same page, can plan trips accounting for everyone's inputs and preferences, and hosts games like Trivia and 20 questions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built this app https://tryravioli.com
It has a companion called Jino that you can share your life with. It understands you, jams with you, but doesn't lecture you. It will push back when it sees you bullshit. It's a friend not an assistant.
mentions.author: raunaksingwi
